title: CYBRIK execution receipt v1
description: The signed, authoritative record of an invocation (strategy 05 §5.5). The Tool Fabric CONTROL PLANE signs the receipt; executors only attest evidence to it and never hold a signing key (ADR-0006 E5; ADR-0004 F6). The receipt binds the resolved arguments, capability digest, policy decision, approval, and the digest-bound delegation chain, so it alone answers 'who allowed this, on whose behalf, for what' (ADR-0006). It contains no credential and no unrestricted raw stdout (strategy 05 §5.5). Receipt/audit write failure MUST block R2/R3 side effects (strategy 05 §11.8). The receipt-signing envelope format is deferred (ADR-0004 F8); `signature` is a reference to it. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED.

id.description: Executor workload identity (SPIFFE-style; ADR-0006 E2 / ADR-0004 F4).

approval_id.description: Present when the gating policy decision required approval.

delegation_ref.description: chain_digest of the delegation chain under which the action was authorized. Binds the receipt to the exact authority used.

credential_lease_id_hash.description: Hash of the single-use credential lease id. The credential itself never appears (ADR-0004 F5).

resolved_arguments_digest.description: Digest of the server-resolved arguments actually executed. An approval bound to different resolved arguments is invalid.

target_digest.description: Digest of the server-resolved target snapshot the effect was applied to.

rollback_handle.description: Opaque rollback handle; not a credential.

receipt_digest.description: Digest over the canonical receipt content (all fields except signature).

signature.description: Reference to the control-plane signature over receipt_digest (signing envelope deferred, ADR-0004 F8). Never produced by an executor.
